writing.exampleCaption: The bound names only what the body actually needs.
writing.explanation: Trait bounds state exactly the capabilities the generic body needs, and the compiler generates a specialised copy per concrete type. That means generics cost nothing at runtime — but a bound wider than necessary narrows who can call you.
writing.feedback: Every unnecessary bound is a caller you turned away.
